title: "census city county lookup"
author: "Peter Franz"
date: "2026-11-20"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(here)

census_dir <- here("data", "census")

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r geographic_matching}

# Load the saved nationwide city and county datasets
national_census_geo <- readRDS(
  file.path(census_dir, "national_census_geo_2024.rds")
)

national_counties_geo <- readRDS(
  file.path(census_dir, "national_counties_geo_2024.rds")
)

# Retrieve 2024 nationwide Census place boundaries
city_boundaries <- tigris::places(
  state = NULL,
  year = 2024,
  cb = TRUE
)

# Keep only places in our existing Census dataset
city_boundaries <- city_boundaries %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% national_census_geo$GEOID)

# Retrieve 2024 county boundaries
county_boundaries <- tigris::counties(
  year = 2024,
  cb = TRUE
)

# Keep only counties in our existing dataset
county_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  filter(GEOID %in% national_counties_geo$GEOID)

# Keep essential identifiers and geometry
city_boundaries <- city_boundaries %>%
  select(
    city_geoid = GEOID,
    city_name = NAME,
    geometry
  )

county_boundaries <- county_boundaries %>%
  select(
    county_geoid = GEOID,
    county_name = NAME,
    geometry
  )

# Convert both datasets to the same projected CRS
city_boundaries <- st_transform(
  city_boundaries,
  crs = 6933
)

county_boundaries <- st_transform(
  county_boundaries,
  crs = 6933
)

# Check the resulting dimensions
dim(city_boundaries)

dim(county_boundaries)
```

```{r simple_county_matching}
# Generate one representative point per Census place
city_points <- st_point_on_surface(city_boundaries)

# Match each point to the county containing it
city_county_lookup <- st_join(
  city_points,
  county_boundaries %>%
    select(county_geoid, county_name),
  join = st_within,
  left = TRUE
)

# Remove geometry and keep matching variables
city_county_lookup <- city_county_lookup %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(
    city_geoid,
    city_name,
    county_geoid,
    county_name
  )

dim(city_county_lookup)

head(city_county_lookup)
```

```{r county_overlap}
# Identify counties whose interiors overlap each Census place
county_overlaps <- st_relate(
  city_boundaries,
  county_boundaries,
  pattern = "T********"
)

# Count counties overlapping each Census place
county_counts <- tibble(
  city_geoid = city_boundaries$city_geoid,
  county_count = lengths(county_overlaps)
)

# Add the ambiguity flag
city_county_lookup <- city_county_lookup %>%
  left_join(
    county_counts,
    by = "city_geoid"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    multiple_counties = county_count > 1
  )

# Summarize results
city_county_lookup %>%
  count(multiple_counties)
```

```{r county_match status}
# Create a descriptive matching status
city_county_lookup <- city_county_lookup %>%
  mutate(
    county_match_status = if_else(
      multiple_counties,
      "Requires county verification",
      "Single-county match"
    )
  )

# Check results
city_county_lookup %>%
  count(county_match_status)
```

```{r city_county_validation}
# Validate the city-to-county lookup
city_county_validation <- city_county_lookup %>%
  summarise(
    total_places = n(),
    missing_counties = sum(is.na(county_geoid)),
    duplicate_cities = sum(duplicated(city_geoid)),
    single_county_places = sum(!multiple_counties),
    multi_county_places = sum(multiple_counties)
  )

city_county_validation
```

```{r}
# Save the completed city-to-county lookup
write_csv(
  city_county_lookup,
  file.path(census_dir, "city_county_lookup_2024.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  city_county_lookup,
  file.path(census_dir, "city_county_lookup_2024.rds")
)

# Save validation results
write_csv(
  city_county_validation,
  file.path(census_dir, "city_county_validation_2024.csv")
)
```
